segments.text: Lesson 44
segments.translation: 第44课

segments.text: Patterns of culture
segments.translation: 文化模式

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: What influences us from the moment of birth?
segments.translation: 什么从我们出生那一刻起就影响着我们？

segments.text: Custom has not commonly been regarded as a subject of any great moment.
segments.translation: 习俗通常不被视为一个多么重要的主题。

segments.text: The inner workings of our own brains we feel to be uniquely worthy of investigation,
segments.translation: 我们觉得自己大脑的内部运作特别值得研究，

segments.text: but custom, we have a way of thinking, is behaviour at is most commonplace.
segments.translation: 但是，习俗，我们倾向于认为，是最普通的行为。

segments.text: As a matter of fact, it is the other way around.
segments.translation: 事实上，恰恰相反。

segments.text: Traditional custom, taken the world over,
segments.translation: 从全世界来看，

segments.text: is a mass of detailed behaviour more astonishing than what any one person can ever evolve in individual actions,
segments.translation: 传统习俗是大量详细行为的集合，比任何个人在个体行为中所能产生的都更令人惊叹，

segments.text: no matter how aberrant.
segments.translation: 无论多么反常。

segments.text: Yet that is a rather trivial aspect of the matter.
segments.translation: 然而，这只是问题的一个相当微不足道的方面。

segments.text: The fact of first-rate importance is the predominant role that custom plays in experience and in belief,
segments.translation: 最重要的事实是习俗在经验和信仰中所起的主导作用，

segments.text: and the very great varieties it may manifest.
segments.translation: 以及它可能表现出的极大多样性。

segments.text: No man ever looks at the world with pristine eyes.
segments.translation: 没有人能用纯净的眼光看世界。

segments.text: He sees it edited by a definite set of customs and institutions and ways of thinking.
segments.translation: 他看到的世界被一套特定的习俗、制度和思维方式所塑造。

segments.text: Even in his philosophical probings he cannot go behind these stereotypes;
segments.translation: 即使在哲学探索中，他也无法超越这些刻板印象；

segments.text: his very concepts of the true and the false will still have reference to his particular traditional customs.
segments.translation: 他关于真假的概念仍然与他特定的传统习俗有关。

segments.text: John Dewey has said in all seriousness that the part played by custom in shaping the behaviour of the individual,
segments.translation: 约翰·杜威曾非常严肃地说过，习俗在塑造个人行为方面的作用，

segments.text: as against any way in which he can affect traditional custom,
segments.translation: 相对于个人能够影响传统习俗的任何方式，

segments.text: is as the proportion of the total vocabulary of his mother tongue
segments.translation: 就如同母语总词汇量的比例

segments.text: against those words of his own baby talk that are taken up into the vernacular of his family.
segments.translation: 相对于他自己婴儿语中被家庭方言吸收的那些词。

segments.text: When one seriously studies the social orders that have had the opportunity to develop autonomously,
segments.translation: 当人们认真研究那些有机会自主发展的社会秩序时，

segments.text: the figure becomes no more than an exact and matter-of-fact observation.
segments.translation: 这个数字就变成了一个精确而实事求是的观察。

segments.text: The life history of the individual is first and foremost an accommodation
segments.translation: 个人的生活史首先是一种适应

segments.text: to the patterns and standards traditionally handed down in his community.
segments.translation: 适应他所在社区传统传承的模式和标准。

segments.text: From the moment of his birth,
segments.translation: 从他出生的那一刻起，

segments.text: the customs into which he is born shape his experience and behaviour.
segments.translation: 他所出生的习俗就塑造了他的经历和行为。

segments.text: By the time he can talk, he is the little creature of his culture,
segments.translation: 到他会说话时，他已是他的文化的小产物，

segments.text: and by the time he is grown and able to take part in its activities,
segments.translation: 到他长大能参加其活动时，

segments.text: its habits are his habits, its beliefs his beliefs, its impossibilities his impossibilities.
segments.translation: 它的习惯就是他的习惯，它的信仰就是他的信仰，它的不可能就是他的不可能。

segments.text: Every child that is born into his group will share them with him,
segments.translation: 出生在他群体中的每个孩子都将与他分享这些，

segments.text: and no child born into one on the opposite side of the globe can ever achieve the thousandth part.
segments.translation: 而出生在地球另一端对立群体中的孩子永远无法达到千分之一。

segments.text: There is no social problem it is more incumbent upon us to understand than this of the role of custom.
segments.translation: 没有哪个社会问题比习俗的作用更需要我们去理解。

segments.text: Until we are intelligent as to its laws and varieties,
segments.translation: 直到我们对其规律和变体有了明智的认识，

segments.text: the main complicating facts of human life must remain unintelligible.
segments.translation: 人类生活的主要复杂事实必定仍然难以理解。

segments.text: The study of custom can be profitable only after certain preliminary propositions have been accepted,
segments.translation: 只有在某些初步命题被接受之后，对习俗的研究才能有所收获，

segments.text: and some of these propositions have been violently opposed.
segments.translation: 而其中一些命题曾遭到激烈反对。

segments.text: In the first place, any scientific study requires that there be no
segments.translation: 首先，任何科学研究都要求

segments.text: preferential weighting of one or another of the items in the series it selects for its consideration.
segments.translation: 在其选择考虑的系列中，对其中某一项不能有优先加权。

segments.text: In all the less controversial fields, like the study of cacti or termites or the nature of nebulae,
segments.translation: 在所有争议较少的领域，如对仙人掌或白蚁或星云性质的研究中，

segments.text: the necessary method of study is to group the relevant material and to take note of all possible variant forms and conditions.
segments.translation: 必要的研究方法是将相关材料分组，并记录所有可能的变体形式和条件。

segments.text: In this way, we have learned all that we know of the laws of astronomy, or of the habits of the social insects, let us say.
segments.translation: 通过这种方式，我们了解了天文学规律或群居昆虫习性的一切知识，可以说。

segments.text: It is only in the study of man himself that the major social sciences
segments.translation: 只有在对人自身的研究中，主要的社会科学

segments.text: have substituted the study of one local variation, that of Western civilization.
segments.translation: 才用一种地方变体——西方文明的研究取代了整体研究。

segments.text: Anthropology was by definition impossible,
segments.translation: 人类学从定义上来说是不可能的，

segments.text: as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive,
segments.translation: 只要我们自己与原始人之间、

segments.text: ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people's minds.
segments.translation: 我们自己与野蛮人之间、我们自己与异教徒之间的这些区别仍然支配着人们的思想。

segments.text: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree of sophistication
segments.translation: 首先必须达到那种复杂程度

segments.text: where we no longer set our own belief against our neighbour's superstition.
segments.translation: 即我们不再将自己的信仰与邻人的迷信对立。

segments.text: It was necessary to recognize that these institutions which are based on the same premises, let us say the supernatural,
segments.translation: 必须认识到这些基于相同前提的制度，比如说超自然，

segments.text: must be considered together, our own among the rest.
segments.translation: 必须放在一起考虑，我们自己的也在其中。
